desc: Derive per-element cost c(x) = floor(log_4 x) + 1, with c(0)=0.
Establish per-query formula min_ops = max(c(r), ceil(sum_{x=l}^{r} c(x) / 2)).
Implement prefix-sum F(n) over intervals [4^{k-1}, 4^k - 1] with integer-safe power handling (no floating point log).
Implement main loop over queries: D = F(r)-F(l-1); accumulate max(c(r), (D+1)//2).
Execute the solution on samples [[1,2],[2,4]] -> 3 and [[2,6]] -> 4; both pass, plus edge cases (l=1, r=4^k, r=10^9, 1e5 queries) verified.
